features.total_packets: Sum of Phase 1 edge packet_count aggregates in the graph window.
features.total_bytes_proxy: Sum of Phase 1 edge byte_count_proxy aggregates in the graph window.
features.mean_packet_size_proxy: Packet-count weighted mean of Phase 1 edge mean_packet_size_proxy.
features.std_packet_size_proxy: Packet-count weighted mean of Phase 1 edge std_packet_size_proxy.
features.mean_interarrival_time: Packet-count weighted mean of Phase 1 edge mean_interarrival_time.
features.std_interarrival_time: Packet-count weighted mean of Phase 1 edge std_interarrival_time.
features.active_nodes: Number of nodes present in the PyG snapshot.
features.active_edges: Number of directed edges present in the PyG snapshot.
features.average_degree: Directed graph total degree average, computed as 2 * active_edges / active_nodes.
features.max_degree: Maximum directed total degree among local nodes in the snapshot.
features.average_peer_count: Mean inverse-transformed Phase 1 node peer_count aggregate.
